overview.location: South side of Milwaukee, Wisconsin — about 5.8 miles south of downtown Milwaukee, between I-41/I-94 and Howell Avenue (WI 38). Renamed from 'General Mitchell International' in February 2019; the FAA and U.S. government still use the old name.
overview.cargoVolume: About 111.4 million lb of cargo and mail in 2025
overview.distinction: Wisconsin's busiest airport. Southwest is the largest carrier (~42% of passengers, Jul 2025-Jun 2026), followed by Delta (~15%). Home of the Mitchell Gallery of Flight museum and the Wisconsin Air National Guard's 128th Air Refueling Wing. Has its own Amtrak station (Milwaukee Airport Rail Station) linked by free shuttle.
overview.dominantAirline: Southwest Airlines (~42% of passengers, Jul 2025-Jun 2026); Delta second (~15%)
overview.totalAirlines: verify — Southwest, Delta, American, United, Frontier, Alaska, Air Canada and regional partners (check mitchellairport.com/flights)
overview.founded: 1920 as Hamilton Airport; bought by Milwaukee County 1926; current terminal opened July 20, 1955
overview.metroAccess: No light rail. MCTS GreenLine (Baggage roadway island outside Exit 2) and Route 80 (Ticketing curb near the American/United entrance). Amtrak Hiawatha/Borealis at Milwaukee Airport Rail Station, linked by free 24/7 shuttle.
overview.peopleMover: None — single terminal with Concourses C and D reached on foot after security.

terminals.name: Main Terminal — Concourse C
terminals.notes: Southwest, MKE's largest carrier, operates here.

terminals.name: Main Terminal — Concourse D
terminals.notes: Delta Sky Club is in Concourse D (verify exact location and hours on delta.com).

terminals.status: Under redevelopment into a new international concourse — work began ~September 2025, completion expected 2027 (verify). The current International Arrivals Building closes once it opens.
terminals.notes: Not a passenger gate area during construction.

groundTransportZones.taxi: Outside Baggage Claim 3 — cross the Baggage Claim roadway and follow signs to the taxi lane behind the rental car area.
groundTransportZones.coaches: Coach USA, Lamers, Badger Coaches and FlixBus stop outside Baggage Claim Exit 2.
groundTransportZones.hotelShuttles: Hotel courtesy shuttle pickup point not published on mitchellairport.com — Triply lots say to call the hotel after you collect bags (verify the exact curb with each hotel).

routes: Route 80 (Ticketing curb near the American/United entrance)
mctsBus.accessFromTerminal: GreenLine: Baggage Claim Exit 2 island. Route 80: Ticketing level curb. Real-time arrival map near Carousel 1.

amtrak.station: Milwaukee Airport Rail Station (MARS), 5601 S. 6th Street
amtrak.shuttle: To the station: Baggage Claim Door #5, board any Saver Parking shuttle and tell the driver. Every 5-10 minutes, 24 hours. From the station: call 414-747-4561 or use the courtesy phone.
amtrak.hours: 5:45 a.m.-10 p.m. Mon-Sat; 7:15 a.m.-10 p.m. Sun
amtrak.parking: $2/hr for the first two hours, max $11 per 24 hours (Amtrak passengers only)

taxi.pickup: Outside Baggage Claim 3, taxi lane behind the rental car area
taxi.note: Fares not published by the airport.

rideshare.note: The app confirms the exact pickup spot.

rentalCars.location: verify — mitchellairport.com does not give the counter/pickup location; car return clearance 6 ft 11 in
rentalCars.note: Turo car sharing also operates at MKE.

otherShuttles.goRiteway: GO Riteway door-to-door shuttle (SE Wisconsin, northern Illinois, Chicago): 1-800-236-5450
otherShuttles.coachUSA: Coach USA (Milwaukee, Waukesha, Racine, Kenosha counties): 262-542-8861
otherShuttles.lamers: Lamers (Wausau, Stevens Point, Appleton, Oshkosh, Fond du Lac): 1-800-261-6600

groundTransportation.hotelShuttles: Triply's four MKE lots are all within ~2.2 miles: Royle Hotel, Best Western Plus and ExecPark on S. Howell Ave (0.7-0.8 mi), Crowne Plaza on S. 13th St (2.2 mi). Call the lot after you collect your bags.

parkingRates: On-airport (daily max): Saver Lot $11 (shuttle, credit card only), Daily Garage $18, Surface Lot $18, Hourly Garage (floors 3-4) $27, Valet $28; all $2/hr. First 30 min free in Hourly, Surface and Cell Phone lots. Off-site via Triply: four lots on Howell Ave / S. 13th St from ~$5.50/day.

saverLot.name: MKE Saver Parking
saverLot.connection: Free shuttle every 5-10 minutes, 24 hours. 'Trunk to Terminal' — shuttle picks up at your car; Parking Ambassadors give you a card with your car's location; on return you're dropped at your vehicle. Most shuttles have wheelchair lifts.
saverLot.features: Lowest-cost on-airport option. Credit card only. ChargePoint EV chargers just east of the main entrance ($5/charge).

dailyGarage.name: MKE Daily Parking (Garage)
dailyGarage.features: All garage floors. Max height 6'11". ChargePoint EV chargers on level 3, yellow section, aisle E.

surfaceLot.name: MKE Surface Parking
surfaceLot.features: Immediately south of the garage. Accepts tall vehicles. First 30 minutes free.

hourlyGarage.name: MKE Hourly Parking (Garage floors 3-4)
hourlyGarage.features: 3rd and 4th floors, RED area. Max height 6'11". First 30 minutes free.

valetParking.name: MKE Valet Parking
valetParking.location: Left side of the ticketing roadway, across from the terminal

motorcycle.name: Motorcycle Parking
motorcycle.location: Covered area on the Baggage Claim roadway; pay by QR code

railStationParking.name: Airport Rail Station Parking (Amtrak passengers only)
railStationParking.location: S. 6th Street, south of Grange Avenue
railStationParking.note: Amtrak passengers only — not for air travelers.

cellPhoneLot.name: Cell Phone Lot
cellPhoneLot.location: Immediately south of the parking structure, within walking distance of the terminal
cellPhoneLot.cost: FREE for 30 minutes or less (then $2/hr — verify)
cellPhoneLot.rules: Stays of 30 minutes or less are free

locations: Daily Garage — level 3, yellow section, aisle E
Saver Lot — just east of the main entrance
evCharging.cost: $5 per charge plus regular parking rates

parkingAdvantageProgram.name: Smart Park Rewards
parkingAdvantageProgram.status: Linked from the parking page; program details not published there — verify
parkingAdvantageProgram.note: Login at parking.mitchellairport.com. The MKE SmartPark app lets you enter and exit facilities by smartphone.

onAirportParking.reservations: Online 'Book Airport Parking' form on mitchellairport.com (promo code field). Full refund if you contact customer service up to 2 hours before the reservation starts.
onAirportParking.accessibleParking: Not detailed on the parking page — verify with MKE Parking (414-747-4561). Most Saver shuttles have wheelchair lifts; a shelter phone can request one.
onAirportParking.paymentMethods: All major credit cards in all lots and the garage; Saver is credit card only. Pay stations at each Skywalk and in Baggage Claim (30 minutes to exit after paying). MKE SmartPark app.
onAirportParking.garageServiceAreas: Hourly, Daily, Surface and Valet → walk to terminal. Saver → 24/7 shuttle.

parkingLots.name: Royle Hotel
parkingLots.shuttleInfo: 4:00 AM-8:00 AM every 30 minutes; 8:00 AM-1:00 AM on demand; no shuttle 1:00 AM-4:00 AM. Check in at the front desk before parking and show your reservation receipt. Arrive at least 20 minutes before you want to be at the terminal. On return, call 414-481-2400 after collecting luggage.
parkingLots.overview: Hotel park-and-fly lot on South Howell Avenue, 0.8 mi from MKE, with a complimentary airport shuttle, 24-hour front desk and accessible parking.
parkingLots.notes: Lowest sellable rate at MKE on 2026-10-16 ($47.28 grand total for a 7-night Nov 2-9 stay, 8 billed days; same on Nov 9-16 and 16-23). Minimum booking 2 days. No shuttle 1-4 AM. Listing name is 'Royle Hotel' but its own description says 'Royce Hotel' — verify spelling before publishing.

parkingLots.name: Best Western Plus
parkingLots.shuttleInfo: Every day 4 AM-12 AM, on demand. Bring proof of booking (phone or printed) to the front desk. To be picked up at the airport, call (414) 769-2100. Arrive at least 30 minutes before you want to be at the terminal.
parkingLots.overview: Best Western Plus Milwaukee Airport Hotel & Conference Center, across the street from MKE on South Howell Avenue, with an on-demand shuttle.
parkingLots.notes: $61.44 grand total for Nov 2-9 (8 billed days), same on all three test weeks. No shuttle 12-4 AM.

parkingLots.name: Crowne Plaza Milwaukee Airport
parkingLots.shuttleInfo: 4:00 AM-11:00 PM on demand; no shuttle 11:00 PM-4:00 AM. Check in at the front desk before parking (a vehicle waiver form is required). For pickup call 414-764-5300. First come, first served — airline crews get priority; arrive 20-30 minutes earlier than you'd like to leave.
parkingLots.overview: Hotel lot minutes from MKE. Free shuttle with online purchase, no room reservation required, and no extra charge for full-size vans, pickup trucks and large SUVs.
parkingLots.notes: $69.58 grand total for Nov 2-9 (8 billed days). Minimum booking 2 days. Crew members get shuttle priority — build in a buffer. Good pick for oversized vehicles. No shuttle 11 PM-4 AM.

parkingLots.name: ExecPark Valet Parking & Shuttle
parkingLots.shuttleInfo: 24/7 on-demand pickup from the airport. Stop outside the office doors to check in (have your email confirmation ready), then ride the shuttle to your airline's ticket counter. On return, call ExecPark after claiming luggage.
parkingLots.overview: Valet lot 5-10 minutes' drive from MKE with a 24-hour office, fenced lot under 24/7 video surveillance, snow and ice cleared from windows in winter, and free jump-starts (not EVs). Diesel/heating plug-ins and car care for an added charge. Spaces for oversized vehicles.
parkingLots.notes: $103.45 grand total for Nov 2-9 (8 billed days). Lot accepts arrivals only 2:30 AM-7 PM CST — closed for drop-off 7 PM-2:30 AM (office 24/7). Only Triply MKE lot with 24/7 shuttle and winter snow clearing.

shuttleInfo: On-airport: Saver Lot shuttle every 5-10 minutes, 24 hours, 'Trunk to Terminal' pickup at your car. Off-site: Triply's four MKE lots are 0.7-2.2 mi away. ExecPark runs 24/7 on demand; Royle Hotel (no shuttle 1-4 AM), Best Western Plus (4 AM-12 AM) and Crowne Plaza (4 AM-11 PM) do not run overnight. Call the lot after collecting bags.
distanceFromCity: About 5.8 miles south of downtown Milwaukee (~15 minutes by car via I-94 — verify drive time).

keyDistances.toHowellAveLots: 0.7-0.8 mi (Triply lots: Royle Hotel, Best Western Plus, ExecPark)
keyDistances.to13thStreetLot: 2.2 mi (Triply lot: Crowne Plaza Milwaukee Airport)
keyDistances.competitiveAdvantage: Three of Triply's four MKE lots are under a mile from the terminal on Howell Ave, so shuttle rides are very short; ExecPark adds valet, 24/7 shuttle and winter snow clearing.

projects: Concourse E international concourse redevelopment (2-5 gates planned); current International Arrivals Building to close after completion.
construction2026.travelImpact: No parking facility closures identified as of 2026-10-16 — verify current alerts before travel.

peakTravelTimes.seasonalPeak: Summer (June-August, incl. Summerfest), spring break, Thanksgiving and Christmas/New Year. Winter getaways to Florida/Arizona drive demand January-March.

weatherPatterns.climate: Humid continental: cold, snowy winters and warm summers moderated by Lake Michigan.
weatherPatterns.commonDisruptions: Snow and lake-effect squalls (November-March); summer thunderstorms; lake fog.
weatherPatterns.winterNote: Allow extra time for snow and ice on I-94 and on hotel shuttle runs. ExecPark clears snow and ice from windows; other off-site lots are self-park.
weatherPatterns.note: Bring a scraper in winter if you park at a self-park hotel lot.

parkSleepFly.description: Hotel + parking + shuttle combos on South Howell Avenue and South 13th Street. Triply sells parking-only at the hotels below; room packages are booked with the hotel.
parkSleepFly.priceRange: Parking-only via Triply from ~$5.50/day (2026-10-16 quote); room package pricing — verify with hotel

savingsComparison.scenario: 7-night trip (Nov 2-9, 2026, 10 AM drop-off / 2 PM pickup — Triply bills 8 days), quoted 2026-10-16. On-airport figures assume 8 days at the daily max (partial-day billing — verify).

crownePlazaMilwaukeeAirport.caveat: No shuttle 11 PM-4 AM; crews get priority

execParkValet.caveat: Valet + 24/7 shuttle + snow clearing; no drop-off 7 PM-2:30 AM

mctsRoundTrip.note: GreenLine or Route 80 to downtown Milwaukee.

savingsComparison.keyDifference: MKE's Saver Lot is cheap at $11/day, so anchor big savings against the $18 Daily/Surface and $27 Hourly garage. Royle Hotel and Best Western Plus still undercut Saver; ExecPark costs slightly more than Saver but adds valet, 24/7 shuttle and winter snow clearing.

uniqueFeatures.billyMitchell: Named for Brigadier General Billy Mitchell, a Milwaukee native often called a father of the U.S. Air Force.
uniqueFeatures.nameChange: Renamed Milwaukee Mitchell International in February 2019; formerly General Mitchell International (FAA still uses the old name).
uniqueFeatures.amtrakStation: One of few U.S. airports with its own Amtrak station (Hiawatha to Chicago), linked by free 24/7 shuttle.
uniqueFeatures.galleryOfFlight: Mitchell Gallery of Flight aviation museum in the terminal.
uniqueFeatures.airGuard: Wisconsin Air National Guard's 128th Air Refueling Wing (KC-135 tankers) is based on airport property.

emergencyContacts.emergency: 911 — state you are at Milwaukee Mitchell Airport
